penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Implementing a reliable audit-and-rollback system spanning 18 months across multiple Salesforce objects requires custom development inside the customer's org — per-customer professional services work, not an automated SaaS delivery.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Scoping, architecting, and validating a long-horizon rollback mechanism for bulk data operations requires live engagement with the customer's data model and business rules — not self-serve.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: An 18-month audit trail with undo capabilities in a production Salesforce org carries high stakes; support queries will require human judgement about data integrity edge cases.

rationale: The buyer is specific and credible — Salesforce architects and senior developers at companies running bulk data operations, who already pay enterprise rates for OwnBackup and Gearset — and the pain is real and business-critical. But this is fundamentally a bespoke professional-services and custom-development problem: no two Salesforce orgs have the same object model, and an 18-month audit-and-rollback system must be architected inside the customer's org. Operational autonomy scores 2 (requires hands-on work for every engagement) and buildability_with_ai scores 3 (needs custom Salesforce Apex development, not a Claude prompt + Stripe). Both build gates fail by large margins, and the total after penalties is 1.6 — well below even the validate threshold.
solution_plan: This is not buildable as a solo non-technical operator using Claude. The problem requires custom Salesforce Apex development, deep knowledge of the customer's data model, and ongoing professional services to implement and maintain. OwnBackup exists precisely because this problem needs dedicated engineering investment. Claude cannot architect an 18-month rollback system across arbitrary Salesforce objects without org-level access and custom code. Drop this opportunity.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy gate (2 < 7), buildability_with_ai gate (3 < 6). Total 1.6 is well below validate threshold (5.5). Drop recommended.
